title: Chapter 150: Upgrading Before The Battle
content:
Chapter 150: Upgrading Before The Battle

The Zerg army in the city surrounded the center of the city. The Zerg puppies, who were still trying their best to fight against the five thousand strong army of the evil god, all rushed towards the enemy!

Three thousand bugbear elite infantry and two thousand long-armed ogre throwers have not been reduced yet. When they saw countless zerg coming from all directions, they quickly retreated to the open space near the square.

Being besieged by a large number of Zerg in complex terrain is far less calm than gathering in an open area to fight against Zerg.

They gathered together to form a dense phalanx to resist the Zerg attack, instead of arrogantly relying on their strength to attack the Zerg puppies.

The spears thrown by the two thousand long-armed ogres were extremely powerful, killing and injuring the Zerg puppies in large numbers. However, the number of spears they carried was limited. By this point in the battle, their number of spears was running low. .

The Zerg puppies, so dark with no end in sight, were like moths to a flame, pounced on the elite bugbear infantry who were far more powerful than them, risking their lives to launch the strongest attack in their lives!

The bugbear infantry panted heavily, holding thick maces in both hands, and kept swinging forward to fight back the Zerg puppies that jumped in front of them!

With powerful and heavy swings, he can repel the Zerg puppies in front of him every time!

The Zerg puppy, facing the blow from the stick, turned into light and disappeared before it fell to the ground, making room for the attack position of its accomplices behind it!

The Zerg puppy's blade arm struck hard on the bugbear infantry, as if it struck an invisible wall. Not only did it not hurt the bugbear infantry, it also caused strong reverberation damage!

The Zerg puppy's attacks are ineffective!

But the Zerg are not afraid of death! do not give up!

Countless Zerg puppies continue to pounce upward! All the Zerg Hydralisks are coming up too!

Countless powerful spikes wrapped in Zerg biological decomposition liquid hit the five thousand enemies who were personally blessed by the evil god like a violent storm!

More than three hundred one-star hydralisks gathered together and fired at an area!

Finally, the bugbear infantry suffered a lot of damage, and the invisible defense on their bodies disappeared!

Even if he had a strength of one star or above, under such a fierce attack, the moment his invisible defense disappeared, he simply turned into light and disappeared!

The Zerg's attack output at this moment is too fierce! It's just that the remaining ordinary armies of evil gods that were affected have all disappeared and become resources of the system!

Testing the limits of the evil god's defensive blessing, Wu Qing selected more than 1,600 hydralisks in the frontline battle, consumed the qi resources he had just accumulated, and upgraded them by one star directly in front of the formation!

On the battlefield, more than 1,600 hydralisks suddenly turned into giant pupae on the spot. In less than a minute, they evolved to a body of more than four meters high and emerged from the pupa!

The number of one-star Zerg Hydralisks suddenly increased to two thousand. Their attack capabilities have been qualitatively improved compared to ordinary Hydralisks!

Two thousand one-star hydralisks first sprayed a large amount of Zerg biological decomposition liquid to cover all the Evil God's army that had been reduced in number. No matter whether this attack was effective or not, we should get it to them first!

Then there are intensive and powerful armor-piercing spike attacks!

The attacks of the one-star hydralisks are very effective. As long as they fire in unison, those bugbear infantry and long-armed ogre throwers will not be able to hold on for long!

Facing the intensive attack of the Zerg Hydralisks, the long-armed ogre thrower threw the few spears in his hand towards the gathering area of the Zerg Hydralisks!

Now the battlefield situation has changed drastically. Many of the spears thrown by the long-armed ogres were hit by the dense Zerg spikes before they flew very far. Even if the spears were blessed with mysterious power, they were still hit by multiple blows. , was knocked down!

Seeing that long-range attacks were no longer effective, the formation of defense turned into waiting for death. The evil god's army, which had not yet reduced its numbers, suddenly launched an assault on the location of the one-star Hydralisk!

All the long-armed ogre throwers, holding a melee spear in their hands, charged closely behind the bugbear elite infantry. They were also good at melee combat!

Faced with such a charge, the Zerg puppies couldn't stop it!

Powerful units form an assault formation, and their ability to penetrate the open battlefield is very strong!

Even if the Zerg puppies on both sides jump into the assault formation, they will not be able to cause effective damage to the attacking enemies.

The enemy's target is the Zerg's one-star Hydralisk. The positions occupied by the Hydralisks are at high places such as houses. The Hydralisks did not retreat. Instead, they seized the opportunity and continuously attacked the attacking enemies, consuming the enemy's defensive blessings. Wait for the enemy to enter a block with relatively complex terrain.

The evil god army left the square area in a surprise attack. Without the strange square interference area behind them, the Zerg puppies rushed up from behind them and surrounded them.

The long-armed ogre held up his spear and engaged in close combat with the Zerg puppies. They were powerful and did not need to consider defense. The Zerg puppies could not slow down their progress for a while!

"The individual combat power of these evil god armies exceeds the one-star range and should reach the two-star level!"

"This is a serious violation of the rules of the world. If you play like this, the world will collapse sooner or later!"

"This is really a world where you can take advantage of loopholes, cheat, and use cheats everywhere!"

Wu Qing couldn't help but sigh when he saw such a powerful enemy suddenly appearing.

There are still so many sacrifices and troops in the square, and I know that the evil god will continue to come up with something.

"There will definitely be a price to pay for this."

"I suspect that the evil god priests are doing this sacrificial ceremony mainly to report the information of our tribe to the evil god."

"The evil god may do this to show his respect for our tribe."

The Queen of Worms expressed her thoughts.

"It makes sense!"

"Maybe you have to take action today!"

Wu Qing felt that when the first evil god priest he saw summoned the evil god, the evil god should have noticed the Zerg.

During this period, the system directly robbed so many evil god believers. It is not surprising that this method would be noticed by the evil god.

In addition, the believers here explicitly reported the threat of the Zerg, which made the evil god take out some things as an exception, causing such a big commotion.

Otherwise, if there is such a big gain from any sacrifice, the evil god's believers will be invincible every time they sacrifice before a battle!

...

The attacking evil god army rushed to the Zerg Hydralisk area with all their strength, regardless of the rapid loss of personnel.

At the same time, they also rushed into the densely populated area of houses.

In just a blink of an eye, the surrounding houses were crawling with Zerg puppies!

Zerg puppies are also called springtails, and their jumping ability is very strong!

A large number of Zerg puppies jumped from the houses into the evil god army. When the number was small, the effect was not great. As more and more Zerg puppies jumped into the evil god army, they slowly slowed down the evil god army's pace!

The surrounding Zerg puppies also swarmed up, pressing up layer by layer!

The evil god army, which had already suffered a huge amount of damage, was gradually overwhelmed by the Zerg puppies!
